content.comment_body: Hello, do the transistor outputs on the [product_name] expansion module include overload or short circuit protection features?
Thank you, I have determined that protection is present. Is there any way to view on the display if an output is overloaded?

You should consider phrasing your questions more clearly next time so it's easier to understand the context. To my knowledge, neither overload nor short circuit (at the load) are indicated on the device display.
Thank you for the feedback—I'll make sure to be clearer in future posts.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are looking for specific details regarding safety features of transistor outputs on [company_name] expansion modules, primarily regarding overload and short circuit protection. The discussion confirms the existence of these protections; however, it appears the device display does not provide real-time feedback or notification about output overloads or short circuits. The lack of display-based alerts may cause delays in identifying and resolving such issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that the equipment will not only integrate overload and short circuit protection for transistor outputs but also provide immediate notifications about these events via the device display.
